Kodaira `?` marks wild additive primes p = 2, 3 where the symbol/f_p/c_p are CITED from the db (our pure-Python wild port is known-broken there — see CLAIMS.md); multiplicative fibers at p = 2, 3 are fully re-derived. The prod c_p column is the cited db CP value; the mult column is the re-derived multiplicative part, checked to divide it exactly (equality when no additive primes occur).

## Mismatches

None: all 284 rank-0 curves agree with every reference quantity (conductor, a_p<=97, L(E,1)/Omega, period, torsion, Sha) at 1e-12 relative tolerance, and every cited prod c_p is exactly divisible by the re-derived multiplicative Tamagawa part.
